extracted.intended_audience: Coq developers, proof engineers, and maintainers writing/coordinating Coq projects
extracted.subtask_description: A code and project style guide specifying formatting, naming, module/section organization, tactic usage, extraction, and repository conventions for Coq developments and contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level principles for the style guide (overview heading).

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles & personas
rubrics_metrics.description: Define roles and personas relevant to Coq projects and style decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the typical use cases the style guide aims to support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Desired outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Intended outcomes from adopting the style guide (overview heading).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mitigate bike-shedding & reduce cognitive load
rubrics_metrics.description: Style choices should reduce unnecessary debate and lower cognitive overhead for contributors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style is enforcable by a linter
rubrics_metrics.description: Style rules should be automatable and enforceable using linters where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find & replace work as expected
rubrics_metrics.description: Naming and layout conventions should allow reliable find-and-replace operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate things are separate; dependencies are easy to trace
rubrics_metrics.description: Project organization should keep distinct concerns separated and make dependencies explicit and traceable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project is robust against changes to the Coq engine
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and project layout should minimize breakage when the Coq engine changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project is minimally impacted by changes in upstream components
rubrics_metrics.description: Upstream changes should have minimal cascading impact on the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upstream maintainers are not punished for offering to help
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and contribution norms should be welcoming to upstream maintainers and not create barriers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project changes have minimal impact on downstream users
rubrics_metrics.description: Project evolution should avoid imposing undue burdens on downstream users.
